import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import cartopy.crs as ccrs
import cartopy.feature as cfeature

def render_frames(start_frame, end_frame, total_frames=900):
    # Washington D.C. and New Delhi coordinates
    lon1, lat1 = -77.0369, 38.9072
    lon2, lat2 = 77.2090, 28.6139

    for frame in range(start_frame, end_frame + 1):
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
        ax = fig.add_subplot(1, 1, 1, projection=ccrs.Robinson())
        ax.set_global()
        
        ax.add_feature(cfeature.LAND, facecolor='lightgray')
        ax.add_feature(cfeature.OCEAN, facecolor='lightblue')
        ax.add_feature(cfeature.COASTLINE, linewidth=0.5)
        ax.add_feature(cfeature.BORDERS, linewidth=0.5, linestyle=':')
        
        # Plot the entire path lightly
        ax.plot([lon1, lon2], [lat1, lat2], transform=ccrs.Geodetic(), color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
        
        progress = frame / total_frames
        
        try:
            import pyproj
            g = pyproj.Geod(ellps='WGS84')
            lonlats = g.npts(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, total_frames)
            current_lon, current_lat = lonlats[frame-1]
            path_lons = [lon1] + [p[0] for p in lonlats[:frame]]
            path_lats = [lat1] + [p[1] for p in lonlats[:frame]]
        except ImportError:
            current_lon = lon1 + (lon2 - lon1) * progress
            current_lat = lat1 + (lat2 - lat1) * progress
            path_lons = np.linspace(lon1, current_lon, frame)
            path_lats = np.linspace(lat1, current_lat, frame)

        ax.plot(path_lons, path_lats, transform=ccrs.Geodetic(), color='red', linewidth=2)
        ax.plot(current_lon, current_lat, transform=ccrs.Geodetic(), marker='o', color='blue', markersize=6)
